name: Bonk.io
tagline: Bump rivals off. Stay on the platform.
description: Move, jump and time your heavy mode to push rival balls off the platforms. Last standing wins a point. Most wins after five rounds takes the match.
howToPlay: Hold Left or Right to roll. Tap Jump to leap from a platform.
Hold Heavy to push harder and resist bumps; release it to move faster.
Fall off and you are out until next round. Last standing wins; most wins after five rounds takes the match.
